title: Frozen documentary claim
description: Extends frame-claim-v1. The field that does the work is `claimed_independent_support`: it is the number the cascade collapse is checked against, and asserting it before the collapse runs is what makes the collapse a refutation attempt rather than a description of the result.

assertion_kind.description: What sort of thing is being claimed. `absence` is separated out because it inherits the archive's survivorship filters fatally: nothing was written, nothing survived, and nothing was catalogued are three different reasons for the same silence.

scope.description: Who, what, where, when. A claim missing any of these is several claims, and the sources will support some of them and not others.

claimed_independent_support.description: How many independent origins the claim asserts, stated BEFORE the chains are followed. Declared after the fact it describes the result; declared before, it is something the result can refute.

derived_from.description: The claim hash this one was narrowed or repaired from. A changed scope is a new claim; it never edits the old one.
